t: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded to Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for discoveries in optogenetics, which uses light to study and control brain cells.
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded to Francis Halzen (University of Wisconsin-Madison) for work on neutrinos that enabled the IceCube Neutrino Observatory in the Antarctic ice.
The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded to Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai for solving how molecules with mirror-image (chiral) forms come to favour one form.
Canadian poet, essayist and classics professor Anne Carson won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature, announced by the Swedish Academy on 8 October 2026.

South African jurist Navanethem 'Navi' Pillay, a former UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, won the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her efforts to promote peace and international law; it was announced in Oslo on 9 October 2026.

The RBI Monetary Policy Committee chaired by Governor Sanjay Malhotra raised the repo rate by 25 basis points from 5.25% to 5.50% on 7 October 2026 and changed its stance from neutral to 'calibrated tightening'.
India finished fourth at the 2026 Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, with 85 medals (21 gold, 27 silver, 37 bronze); China topped the table.
